assessment: B-level decision page for "subdomain vs subfolder" (390/mo, KD 10): the verdict card answers the choice above the fold, every H2 opens with a direct answer, and the recommendation is backed by AEOeye's own measurements (AEOeye Technical SEO Baseline (391 sites, 2026-10-24)) with limitations stated.

topic.readerProblem: A site owner deciding "subdomain vs subfolder" needs a straight recommendation and the evidence for it.
topic.connection: The free SEO audit flags exactly this decision on real sites (redirect types, HTTPS, structure, image formats); the page links into it.

sources.supports: Pros/cons of ccTLDs, subdomains and subdirectories for multi-regional sites.
Site names supported per domain or subdomain, not at the subdirectory level.
Favicon must be square, at least 8x8 px, recommended >48x48; Googlebot-Image crawls it; no subdirectory homepages.
Domain property includes all subdomains and protocols.
URL mapping, keep redirects at least 1 year, avoid redirecting many URLs to the homepage (soft 404), Change of Address.
Robots.txt spec: 500 KiB limit, 4xx = no restrictions, 5xx = stop 12h then last good copy up to 30 days, least restrictive rule wins, crawl-delay unsupported, 24h cache.

checks: Re-read every factual claim against the cited primary sources, fetched on 2026-10-24 (6 sources listed on the page); unverifiable statements were removed or reworded before publishing.
content-lint passed with no errors: 1270 words, 2 Pexels images, 7 inline source links, 5 internal links, 4 FAQs, 10 H2 sections.
Title/H1, secondary-keyword H2s and meta description match the locked three-round plan in docs/seo-v2/final-table.json.
Rendered on the local build at a 375 px mobile viewport: no horizontal overflow (document scrollWidth equals the viewport width).
Recomputed every figure quoted from AEOeye Technical SEO Baseline (391 sites, 2026-10-24) from the raw files in /public/resources.

artifacts.description: AEOeye Technical SEO Baseline (391 sites, 2026-10-24) — the raw data behind the figures quoted in this decision page.

methodology: Figures come from AEOeye's own zero-cost measurements published under /resources: plain HTTP requests from a self-identified research user agent (AEOeyeResearch), robots.txt respected, 1 s between requests per domain; encoding tests run locally with cwebp/avifenc and SSIM via ffmpeg. Each dataset file states its exact method.
limitations: Convenience sample of well-known sites (not the whole web), homepages only, a single snapshot on 2026-10-24; the image test covers 20 screenshots, not photographs.
